title: Kenworth T909 FUPS Custom Road Train Bullbar #10
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar 381 style channel with skirt. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. 100mm box uprights shown. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Optional Dangerous Goods sign. Provision for front mudflaps. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
